event.content:
Viktor.Adler.Areo00187 peeled out of his training gear in the tiny hygiene pod. When he heard the first dull thud on the door of his sub-habitat, his adrenaline spiked. The next instant, the metal plate crashed to the floor, bent out of recognition. The Areopolis security guards trampled it as they rushed in.
Halfway dressed in his tight GraviBall overalls, he lunged forward to block the access to his computer terminal. He tripped over a dangling sleeve, and his outstretched arm was intercepted and twisted behind his back before he had even hit the floor. With his cheek pressed to the smooth, cool surface, he watched, together with his visitors, as countless lines of evidence ran down the screen. His body squirmed under the guard’s expert grip, and his legs kicked violently. He screamed and started up in his hibernation pod with a pounding heart and splitting headache.
